title: 亚洲早盘欧元急跌：0.8%跌破上周低点，17个月低位谁在卖？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: And Paul, it's usual when we speak to you, given where you are positioned in the world that we talk mostly about things that are happening in the Asian markets.
segments.zh: 保罗，我们跟你聊的时候，通常因为你在全球市场的位置，主要谈亚洲市场动态。

segments.en: Well, today, the thing that was happening in the Asian markets was that the Euro was selling off substantially.
segments.zh: 今天亚洲市场发生的事，就是欧元大幅走低。

segments.en: What did you make of that? Quite decisive action on the Euro.
segments.zh: 你怎么看？欧元走势相当果断。

segments.en: Good morning, Anna. Absolutely. That was what was catching our attention and the Asian traders' attention as well.
segments.zh: 早上好，安娜。确实如此。这吸引了我们和亚洲交易员的注意。

segments.en: This morning, quite a big leg lower in the Euro.
segments.zh: 今早欧元出现一波较大下跌。

segments.en: Well, unusually large move and volume for our time of day and taking out, you know, last week's lows.
segments.zh: 这个时段的波动和成交量都异常大，跌破了上周低点。

segments.en: And there was a little moment where it really looked like the losses were accelerating.
segments.zh: 有一刻看起来跌幅确实在加速。

segments.en: I think we got down to about 0.8% on Euro dollar lower on the day.
segments.zh: 欧元兑美元当日跌幅大约到0.8%。

segments.en: You know, the market is factoring in a bunch of different things here.
segments.zh: 市场正在消化一系列不同因素。

segments.en: The political risk in Europe, obviously, is one thing.
segments.zh: 欧洲的政治风险，显然是一个因素。

segments.en: The possibility that the ECB pivots doesn't hike quite so aggressively or maybe even takes more firm action in order to contain the bonds market.
segments.zh: 欧洲央行可能转向，不再那么激进加息，甚至采取更坚定措施来遏制债券市场。

segments.en: Perhaps slowing the pace of QT, perhaps using its transmission protection instrument, although that seems less likely.
segments.zh: 或许放缓量化紧缩步伐，或许动用传导保护工具，尽管这似乎不太可能。

segments.en: But if the ECB were to slow interest rate hikes, that would bring down those short determined bond yields and that's what we're seeing in the market today.
segments.zh: 但如果欧洲央行放缓加息，将拉低那些短期债券收益率，这正是今天市场所见。

segments.en: It's also that concern that the Japanese investors, which hold a large amount of French government bonds, are starting to liquidate more of their holdings.
segments.zh: 还有担忧是，持有大量法国政府债券的日本市场参与者开始减持更多持仓。

segments.en: Again, that would be something that would add to pressure on the Euro.
segments.zh: 这同样会加剧欧元压力。

segments.en: So, quite a cacophony of risk for us in the Euro area to start our day.
segments.zh: 因此，欧元区开局面临一系列风险交织。
